decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress high-pressure geothermal probe is a flagship innovation in a growing geothermal market tied to the heat transition, so the firm keeps it.
The single-U borehole heat exchanger is a standard, high-volume item in the geothermal portfolio and fits rising demand for heat pumps.
The surface technology adds value to the firm's geothermal probes at low additional cost, so keeping it is sensible.
Fire-protection steel profile systems are certified, sought-after products in facade and door construction and lie close to the firm's core steel systems business.
Slim steel profiles meet the architectural demand for minimalist glazing and strengthen the firm's core building systems line.
Decorative surface options are a niche but cheap way to differentiate the profile systems and support individualized customer solutions.
